route_exclusive.rule: Exactly one route executes. The not-taken route closes [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a #### Reasoned Exclusions record naming the Phase 3 measurement.

process_constraints: All commands run in the FOREGROUND with an explicit `timeout` prefix; run_in_background is prohibited for every command in this plan.
Phase 2 probe campaign has a hard 45-minute total wall-clock ceiling and a bounded repetition count of 3 draws per formula.
A probe that hits its timeout is a recorded data point, not a blocker: log it and continue.
Do not modify oracle/run-oracle-suite.sh or .github/workflows/unstable-watch.yml; the extracted classifier module is the sanctioned extension point.
key_findings_for_implementer: max_rlimit is already plumbed ExampleSettings -> ModelDefaults.solve()/re_solve() -> Z3SolverAdapter.set_rlimit(), but Z3OracleProvider.find_countermodel() builds its own settings dict and never sets it. That gap is the Route A fix.

DEFECT IN THE NAIVE FALLBACK: extending MAX_TIME_BY_NODEID_FRAGMENT alone would NOT work. That classify() path also requires FAILURE_SIGNATURE == 'Test failed for example:' in the failure text; these tests fail with an uncaught OracleTimeoutError, which does not contain that string. Route B needs a dedicated classify() branch following the GATING_FLOOR_NODEID_FRAGMENT pattern.

The prior docstrings' 80.6s/107.4s heavy draws were measured under PINNED non-default sat/smt.random_seed values. Production sets no seed, so those figures describe a distribution the test never samples.
oracle/run-oracle-suite.sh already carries `and not unstable` on BOTH passes; no edit is needed there under either route.
The file's own house constant TEMPORAL_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS = 180000 already exceeds both tests' current 150000/60000 budgets and exists for temporal_depth>0 formulas, which both target formulas are.

open_items_disposition.no_direct_repro: Not planned as a sampling campaign (cost/ceiling). A cheap FORCED repro under a deliberately tiny budget is planned in Phase 2 step 5 to capture the verbatim failure text Route B's classifier needs.
open_items_disposition.z3_vs_host_variance: PLANNED - this is the load-bearing measurement. Phase 2 reads rlimit alongside wall time at zero incremental cost; the answer selects the route.
open_items_disposition.n_contention_untested: Not planned. Both tests are xdist_serial and run-oracle-suite.sh routes them to the contention-free pass 2, so an -n 6 measurement would characterize a path the gating suite never takes. Phase 7 re-verifies both markers survive.
open_items_disposition.ci_flake_history: Bounded non-blocking single `gh run list` query with timeout 60 in Phase 2 step 6; unavailability is recorded and the phase proceeds.
